jobs.title: Director, Wealth Management Technology
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 258158

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director, International Wealth Management is accountable for developing, leading, and overseeing delivery teams who are responsible for working with cross-functional development teams and business stakeholders to define and implement business strategies, product roadmaps, service offerings and new features.

The Director contributes to the long-term profitability of the International Wealth Management business line by establishing performance goals and work practices which drive the design and development of high-quality products and solutions.

This is a demanding hands-on and strategic role which requires the incumbent to be knowledgeable of the financial services sector and emerging trends in the Wealth and Asset Management industry.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Management and oversight for delivery of a portfolio of initiatives focused on client and advisor solutions, ensuring that the deliverable align with strategic priorities.
Lead and drive a customer focused culture throughout the delivery teams to influence a client-centered design culture and to deepen relationships with business stakeholders and leverage broader bank relationships, systems, processes and knowledge.
Understand and keep up to date with emerging technologies, trends and innovative solutions across the industry.
Collaborate with business SMEs and technology teams to create platform roadmaps that align and assist in moving business strategies forward.
Provide guidance to stakeholders to ensure prioritization is driven by business value.
Define, lead and execute a cohesive strategy designed to limit technological debt and to effectively manage transition from legacy systems to modern technology platforms, maximizing operational efficiencies.
Excellent relationship building, influencing and negotiation skills to build and maintain strong supportive relationships with stakeholders across the organization.
Manage engagement with bank stakeholders and effectively communicate product release contents and expected product capabilities/customer journey.
Engage with the engineering and design teams to help determine the best technical implementation methods as well as a reasonable implementation schedule to launch products on a regular basis.
Manage communications and status reporting of ongoing initiatives, including summarizing project risks and options and facilitating prompt decisions when needed.
Maintain an understanding of financial services markets, the competitive landscape and digital transformation trends relative to the Wealth and Asset Management sector and client/user needs and requirements.
You possess a visionary and strategic leadership while inspiring team of solution architects and engineers to embrace your vision and be best in class team responsible for implementing and maintaining Wealth Technology solutions.
You are future focused with the ability to develop roadmaps and build business cases including benefits and costs
You thrive in providing strong leadership and driving employee empowerment and a high degree of engagement.
You excel in overseeing the architecture and design of solutions for the enterprise in a large and distributed environment.
You have experience delivering complex projects providing global, innovative solutions that improve the delivery of Wealth products
You excel in the assessment and selection of Global Wealth technologies and integration partners.
You excel in relationship, stakeholder management and influencing and negotiation skills, effective at all levels up to senior executives.
You can efficiently perform management tasks including incident response and escalations; vendor & contract management; infrastructure management and service resiliency; and service ownership.
You enjoy challenges of working on different types of projects (from large complex to simple).
You collaborate with various business functions to ensure Wealth Technology meets business needs.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

Individual projects range from Minor Enhancements ($50K+) to major strategic initiatives with $10MM+ budgets in a given year.
Demonstrated success delivering applications in an agile environment, strong organization and planning skills with a track record of successful delivery
Experience in leading and coaching delivery teams, with track record of attracting and developing talent
Critical thinking skills: using logic and reasoning to evaluate alternative solutions, recommendations, summarize conclusions and approaches to mitigate risks
Demonstrated ability to achieve strategic goals
Ability to develop strong working relationships with business and technology partners
Relevant working experience in the financial sector, Wealth and Asset Management experience
Understanding of the regulatory environment and parameters impacting the design and delivery of products and services within the Asset Management industry

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
Dynamic Ecosystem - Free tea & coffee, universal washrooms, and lots of space for team collaboration.
Community Engagement - We offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe
, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.
Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.
You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering

Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability

Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution

Own the architecture end-to-end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
jobs.description:
Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Business - Credit

Brookfield Credit manages approximately $305 billion of assets globally, focused on a broad range of private credit investment strategies, including infrastructure and renewable credit, real estate, asset backed, and corporate credit. Return profiles span investment grade, sub-investment grade, and opportunistic. The business combines Brookfield’s substantial credit history with strategic partners, including Oaktree Capital Management, Castlelake, LCM Partners, 17Capital, and Primary Wave Music. As one of the world’s largest and most experienced credit managers globally, we deliver flexible, specialized capital solutions to borrowers, and attractive risk-adjusted returns to our investors

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

The Director, FP&A will join the Brookfield Credit Group Finance team and will report into Senior Vice President, Finance. The Director will primarily be responsible for supporting Brookfield’s Credit business with planning and forecasting processes, including trend analysis and tracking performance against our financial targets. The successful candidate will prepare clear and thoughtful analyses in support of a large variety of deliverables and presentations. The successful candidate will also work collaboratively with various stakeholders, including the broader finance and operations teams across our partner managers, BAM and BN.

Responsibilities:

Oversee FP&A consolidation for BAM’s global Credit segment, including forecasts, business plans and quarterly non-GAAP results, ensuring completeness, accuracy and appropriate review of key outputs
Own the OneStream FP&A system for the Credit segment, including oversight of system changes, enhancements and ongoing utilization to support management reporting, forecasting and analysis
Serve as first reviewer of consolidated forecasts, actual results and business plans, including detailed analysis of key drivers, trends and variances prior to senior team review
Manage quarterly timelines and deliverables across the Credit Group, ensuring operating company submissions are received, reviewed and submitted to BAM in accordance with required deadlines
Coordinate quarterly earnings, forecast and actuals submissions for Credit Segment into BAM reporting, ensuring submissions are complete, accurate and aligned with required timelines
Perform first review of corporate forecasts prepared by financial analyst, incorporating input from the VP Controller as required
Prepare quarterly Credit sub-segment profitability analysis, including detailed review of performance drivers and trends
Prepare and review quarterly results presentation decks and present results to members of senior management
Serve as a key finance liaison with the Credit segment’s largest subsidiary, supporting its finance team through business planning, reporting and issue resolution
Manage 1–2 Financial Analysts responsible for preparing consolidated forecasts, results and business plans, while remaining hands-on in detailed review, analysis and execution of core FP&A deliverables
Build strong relationships across the organization and with portfolio companies, fostering open communication, collaboration and effective problem-solving to support timely, accurate and decision-useful reporting
Identify and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, productivity and scalability of FP&A reporting, forecasting and analysis

Qualifications & Requirements:

Degree in finance, accounting or related business discipline and CPA designation
8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A or Financial Reporting
1-2 years of professional finance management experience
Expert with MS Office (MS Excel, PowerPoint); Experience with OneStream a plus
Strong quantitative and analytical skills, sound judgment, and the ability to assess complex situations and make clear recommendations
Highly organized self-starter with strong communication skills, sound professional ethics, and a commitment to continuous improvement

Salary Range: $150,000 - $170,000 CAD

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Toronto or Waterloo, hybrid | Full-time | Reports to the CEO

Build the finance function at a fast-growing senior care technology company shipping hardware to 24 countries.

The Company

We went from a lab in Waterloo to 24 countries in five years. Our sensors detect falls and track sleep, health and wellness, with no cameras, wearables or pendants. Families get peace of mind. Older adults keep their independence. Our CTO, Dr. Yihong Qi, holds 680 patents, and the next few hundred get built here.

Why now

We are scaling. One of the largest deals in our history is in delivery, our consumer product launches in January, and we are preparing our next raise. Every one of those runs on numbers leadership can trust: a close that lands on time, a forecast that ties sales to inventory and cash, and books that hold up in diligence. This is the moment to bring in the leader who owns it.

The role

This is the senior finance role at Pontosense. You own the close, the forecast, controls and the numbers behind our next raise, across our entities in Canada and China. You work directly with the CEO and the leadership team, and you are in the room with investors. This is a builder role first and an operator role second. You set up how finance runs here, then you run it.

What You'll Own

A monthly close that is reliable and consolidated across Canada and China, landing by business day 10
A forecast the company actually runs on, with sales, inventory and cash tied together
Product costing that is right: landed cost, COGS and inventory planning for hardware built overseas
The raise: the model, the data room and investor reporting, with you in the room
Annual financials prepared and audited on time, and the relationships with our auditors and tax advisors
Controls that hold up across two countries: approvals, spend and intercompany
A seat at the leadership table

What Year One Looks Like

The books close on time every month, consolidated. The forecast is trusted, and inventory is planned, not guessed. Audited financials are current, and our next raise runs on numbers that hold up in diligence.

How We Work

Build it right, then make it better. People's safety rides on what we ship, so we test hard and never settle for good enough.
Say it as it is. Kind and direct, at every level, including the CEO.
Real impact. There is more room to make a difference here than at a company ten times our size.
Do what you said. Trust is built on follow-through, and we return it with real ownership.
Hard, and worth it. What we build keeps someone's parent safe at home. Rest well, it's part of the job.

This is for you if

You'd rather own a problem than be assigned a task
You want the mission to matter and the pace to be real
You're happy to be the person who just fixes it

This isn't for you if

You want a playbook handed to you
You need a big team before you can move

You'll thrive here if

You are a CPA who started in audit, then grew with a product or technology company, with promotions along the way
You have owned the close and built the model yourself, not just reviewed them
You have run FP&A, not only the close: budgets, forecasts and the model leadership makes decisions on
You have worked with inventory, COGS and supply chain costing. Multi-entity or international consolidation is a strong plus
You have worked with investors, a board or lenders, or are ready to step into that
You explain the numbers plainly to people outside finance, and decide with incomplete information
You are as happy reconciling an account yourself as setting the strategy

You don't need to check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.

Where this goes

As we raise and scale, this role grows into leading a finance team of your own.

What You Get

A sensor for your parents, on us
Direct access to the leadership team. No layers.
Fair pay, with the opportunity for equity
Impact decides your pay and your path, not tenure
Hybrid in Toronto or Waterloo, remote if that's where you do your best work
Health, dental and vision benefits

The details

Pay: $160,000 to $190,000 CAD base salary
This is a new role, created to grow the team, not a backfill
How we hire: typically an initial interview, a short case, and a final interview in person with our CEO and members of the team. We may adjust this depending on the role
We leverage AI tools in our hiring process, but prioritize human input and manual review

Our Commitment

At Pontosense, we are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and accessible to all. We value diversity and believe that everyone deserves an equal opportunity to succeed.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know. We will work with you to make the necessary accommodations to ensure a fair and positive experience for all applicants.

We strive to provide accessible communication and technology for our employees and customers and always look for ways to improve. If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve accessibility in our workplace, please don't hesitate to contact us.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply for open positions at our company.

About the Opportunity

Lead the preparation and review of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS
and applicable regulatory requirements.
Oversee the financial reporting process
, ensuring accurate, timely, and complete reporting to senior management, the Board, and other stakeholders.
Manage the year-end audit process
, serving as the primary contact for external auditors and coordinating the preparation of audit schedules and supporting documentation.
Ensure appropriate application and interpretation of new and evolving IFRS standards
, assessing their impact on the organization and implementing required changes.
Oversee technical accounting matters
, including complex transactions, revenue recognition, leases, financial instruments, consolidations, and other IFRS-related issues.
Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls
to ensure compliance with IFRS and promote the integrity of financial reporting.
Lead the month-end and quarter-end close processes
, identifying opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency, and timeliness.
Review financial results and provide variance analysis and financial insights
to senior leadership, highlighting key business drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Oversee the preparation of management reporting, financial analysis, budgets, forecasts, and financial models
to support strategic decision-making.
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance and accounting team
, fostering a high-performing environment with strong accountability, technical expertise, and continuous improvement.

General Financial Oversight:
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, highlighting key metrics and trends.
Assist in developing financial policies, procedures, and internal controls to streamline financial operations.
Work closely with senior leadership to support business decisions and optimize financial performance.
Assist in preparing for audits, including providing necessary documentation for revenue and payroll audits.
Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding payroll and revenue recognition.

Process Improvement:
Continuously assess and improve payroll and revenue recognition processes to increase efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
Identify and implement automation opportunities to streamline payroll processing and financial reporting.
Collaborate with IT and software vendors to maintain and optimize payroll and accounting systems.

Skills
Exceptional attention to detail with a high level of accuracy.
Strong problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.
Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.).

About You

CPA or other relevant certifications preferred.
5+ years of experience in accounting or finance, with a focus on IFRS reporting.
Strong knowledge of IFRS
and experience preparing and reviewing complex financial statements and disclosures.
Experience leading external audits and working effectively with external auditors and other key stakeholders.
Proven experience managing month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial reporting processes
.
Strong understanding of revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 or equivalent).
Solid understanding of accounting principles and regulatory requirements

new_jobs.title: Director, Wealth Management Technology
new_jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 258158

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director, International Wealth Management is accountable for developing, leading, and overseeing delivery teams who are responsible for working with cross-functional development teams and business stakeholders to define and implement business strategies, product roadmaps, service offerings and new features.

The Director contributes to the long-term profitability of the International Wealth Management business line by establishing performance goals and work practices which drive the design and development of high-quality products and solutions.

This is a demanding hands-on and strategic role which requires the incumbent to be knowledgeable of the financial services sector and emerging trends in the Wealth and Asset Management industry.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Management and oversight for delivery of a portfolio of initiatives focused on client and advisor solutions, ensuring that the deliverable align with strategic priorities.
Lead and drive a customer focused culture throughout the delivery teams to influence a client-centered design culture and to deepen relationships with business stakeholders and leverage broader bank relationships, systems, processes and knowledge.
Understand and keep up to date with emerging technologies, trends and innovative solutions across the industry.
Collaborate with business SMEs and technology teams to create platform roadmaps that align and assist in moving business strategies forward.
Provide guidance to stakeholders to ensure prioritization is driven by business value.
Define, lead and execute a cohesive strategy designed to limit technological debt and to effectively manage transition from legacy systems to modern technology platforms, maximizing operational efficiencies.
Excellent relationship building, influencing and negotiation skills to build and maintain strong supportive relationships with stakeholders across the organization.
Manage engagement with bank stakeholders and effectively communicate product release contents and expected product capabilities/customer journey.
Engage with the engineering and design teams to help determine the best technical implementation methods as well as a reasonable implementation schedule to launch products on a regular basis.
Manage communications and status reporting of ongoing initiatives, including summarizing project risks and options and facilitating prompt decisions when needed.
Maintain an understanding of financial services markets, the competitive landscape and digital transformation trends relative to the Wealth and Asset Management sector and client/user needs and requirements.
You possess a visionary and strategic leadership while inspiring team of solution architects and engineers to embrace your vision and be best in class team responsible for implementing and maintaining Wealth Technology solutions.
You are future focused with the ability to develop roadmaps and build business cases including benefits and costs
You thrive in providing strong leadership and driving employee empowerment and a high degree of engagement.
You excel in overseeing the architecture and design of solutions for the enterprise in a large and distributed environment.
You have experience delivering complex projects providing global, innovative solutions that improve the delivery of Wealth products
You excel in the assessment and selection of Global Wealth technologies and integration partners.
You excel in relationship, stakeholder management and influencing and negotiation skills, effective at all levels up to senior executives.
You can efficiently perform management tasks including incident response and escalations; vendor & contract management; infrastructure management and service resiliency; and service ownership.
You enjoy challenges of working on different types of projects (from large complex to simple).
You collaborate with various business functions to ensure Wealth Technology meets business needs.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

Individual projects range from Minor Enhancements ($50K+) to major strategic initiatives with $10MM+ budgets in a given year.
Demonstrated success delivering applications in an agile environment, strong organization and planning skills with a track record of successful delivery
Experience in leading and coaching delivery teams, with track record of attracting and developing talent
Critical thinking skills: using logic and reasoning to evaluate alternative solutions, recommendations, summarize conclusions and approaches to mitigate risks
Demonstrated ability to achieve strategic goals
Ability to develop strong working relationships with business and technology partners
Relevant working experience in the financial sector, Wealth and Asset Management experience
Understanding of the regulatory environment and parameters impacting the design and delivery of products and services within the Asset Management industry

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
Dynamic Ecosystem - Free tea & coffee, universal washrooms, and lots of space for team collaboration.
Community Engagement - We offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. If you require technical assistance, please click here. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

new_jobs.title: Finance Director (6 month contract)
new_jobs.description:
This is a 6 month contract with permanent potential at the end of the contract

About the Opportunity

Lead the preparation and review of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS
and applicable regulatory requirements.
Oversee the financial reporting process
, ensuring accurate, timely, and complete reporting to senior management, the Board, and other stakeholders.
Manage the year-end audit process
, serving as the primary contact for external auditors and coordinating the preparation of audit schedules and supporting documentation.
Ensure appropriate application and interpretation of new and evolving IFRS standards
, assessing their impact on the organization and implementing required changes.
Oversee technical accounting matters
, including complex transactions, revenue recognition, leases, financial instruments, consolidations, and other IFRS-related issues.
Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls
to ensure compliance with IFRS and promote the integrity of financial reporting.
Lead the month-end and quarter-end close processes
, identifying opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency, and timeliness.
Review financial results and provide variance analysis and financial insights
to senior leadership, highlighting key business drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Oversee the preparation of management reporting, financial analysis, budgets, forecasts, and financial models
to support strategic decision-making.
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance and accounting team
, fostering a high-performing environment with strong accountability, technical expertise, and continuous improvement.

General Financial Oversight:
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, highlighting key metrics and trends.
Assist in developing financial policies, procedures, and internal controls to streamline financial operations.
Work closely with senior leadership to support business decisions and optimize financial performance.
Assist in preparing for audits, including providing necessary documentation for revenue and payroll audits.
Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding payroll and revenue recognition.

Process Improvement:
Continuously assess and improve payroll and revenue recognition processes to increase efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
Identify and implement automation opportunities to streamline payroll processing and financial reporting.
Collaborate with IT and software vendors to maintain and optimize payroll and accounting systems.

Skills
Exceptional attention to detail with a high level of accuracy.
Strong problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.
Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.).

About You

CPA or other relevant certifications preferred.
5+ years of experience in accounting or finance, with a focus on IFRS reporting.
Strong knowledge of IFRS
and experience preparing and reviewing complex financial statements and disclosures.
Experience leading external audits and working effectively with external auditors and other key stakeholders.
Proven experience managing month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial reporting processes
.
Strong understanding of revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 or equivalent).
Solid understanding of accounting principles and regulatory requirements
